title: 28 联络29 考察30 画境
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位
content_zh:
;;
齐知玄顿时脸一黑，没想到闾顺安竟然好这口？
二人正聊着。
蓦然！
齐知玄后脖颈的汗毛倒竖起来，他缓慢地转过身。
就看到。
马绍波一脸笑吟吟的出现在齐知玄身后，双手背在身后，用听不出情绪的语气问道：“聊什么呢，这么开心？”
老鸨哈哈一笑，把闾顺安招揽齐知玄的事，当成笑料说了。
马绍波瞬间被逗乐了，嘴角浮现一抹戏谑，调侃道：“呦呵，那我可要恭喜大虎兄弟了。如果你能得到闾堂主的宠爱，那便是飞上枝头变凤凰，以后我们都要仰你鼻息了。”
齐知玄压住怒火，默默转身走开。
他已经知道自己想知道的。
现在的问题是：
小潘头是怎么知道闾顺安是叛徒的？
杀死小潘头那三个青年，是不是闾顺安的手下，为了灭口？
更重要的是，这个情报应该如何才能传递给怒风帮。
直接上门去讲？
你有证据吗？
仅凭小潘头临死前一句话，还没有第二个人可以作证。
口空白牙，无凭无据，怒风帮的人又不是傻子，凭什么相信齐知玄一个外人的话呢？
更别提闾顺安是一位堂主，有权有势。

只要齐知玄证明不了闾顺安是叛徒，那闾顺安必定会杀了齐知玄灭口。
“特么的，这笔钱不好挣啊！”
齐知玄双手交叉于胸前，低头沉思，开动脑筋。
片刻后，他抬起头，嘴角浮现一抹狰狞冷笑。
戌时下班。
齐知玄拿了厨房里的油灯返回宿舍，用被褥挡住门缝。
接着，他取出笔、墨，又掏出一张新的油纸。
“装备‘穷书生的笔’！”
齐知玄铺展开油纸，拿着笔，脑海中回想一个人的笔迹。
马绍波的笔迹！
尽管齐知玄只看过马绍波写过一次字，但因为笔迹实在太丑而印象深刻。
“穷书生书法了得，擅长模仿任何人的笔迹。”
齐知玄酝酿一下，写下一段丑字：

Qi Zhixuan's face turned dark immediately. He didn't expect Lu Shunan to be so fond of this?
The two were chatting.
Suddenly!
The hairs on the back of Qi Zhixuan's neck stood up, and he turned around slowly.
Just see it.
Ma Shaobo appeared behind Qi Zhixuan with a smile on his face, his hands behind his back, and asked in an emotionless tone: "What are you talking about? Are you so happy?"
The old madam laughed and took Lu Shunan's recruitment of Qi Zhixuan as a joke.
Ma Shaobo was instantly amused. A hint of joking appeared at the corner of his mouth, and he joked: "Hey, I would like to congratulate brother Dahu. If you can get the favor of Master Lu, you will fly up the branches and become a phoenix. From now on, we will all look up to you."
Qi Zhixuan suppressed his anger, turned around and walked away silently.
He already knew what he wanted to know.
The question now is:
How did little Pantou know that Lu Shunan was a traitor?
Was it Lu Shunan's men who killed the three young men of Xiao Pantou in order to silence them?
More importantly, how should this information be passed on to the Stormrage Gang.
Go directly to your door to talk?
Do you have evidence?
Based on Xiao Pantou's words before his death, there is no second person who can testify.
They speak with empty teeth and no evidence. The people of the Stormrage Gang are not fools. Why should they believe the words of an outsider, Qi Zhixuan?
Not to mention that Lu Shunan is a powerful leader.
As long as Qi Zhixuan cannot prove that Lu Shun'an is a traitor, then Lu Shun'an will definitely kill Qi Zhixuan to silence him.
"Damn it, it's hard to make this money!"
Qi Zhixuan crossed his hands on his chest, lowered his head and meditated, using his brain.
After a moment, he raised his head, a ferocious sneer appearing on the corner of his mouth.
Get off work at Xu time.
Qi Zhixuan took the oil lamp from the kitchen and returned to the dormitory, using the quilt to block the crack in the door.
Then, he took out his pen, ink, and a new piece of oil paper.
"Equip the 'poor scholar's pen'!"
Qi Zhixuan spread out the oil paper, held a pen, and recalled a person's handwriting in his mind.
Ma Shaobo’s handwriting!
Although Qi Zhixuan had only seen Ma Shaobo write once, he was deeply impressed because his handwriting was so ugly.
"The poor scholar has excellent calligraphy and is good at imitating anyone's handwriting."
Qi Zhixuan thought about it and wrote an ugly word:
